name: sargasso_windrow
theme: a moonlit sargassum raft combed into a wind-lane on the deep-water sea, read as one combing repeated at every scale — the raft's crowded commons, down into a gold float and its brown-alga cells, into the casing's amber chains zipped side by side by calcium beads, to a carbon atom and a splitting cascade of luminous tracks, which folds out as galaxies streaming down parallel filaments into one cluster knot, and home by the knot's brightest galaxy, a star with its comet shoal, an ocean world, and the weed lanes on its night sea

registers.name: weed_raft
registers.palette: kelp-gold weed, moonlit ultramarine sea, foam-ivory streaks
registers.scene: a raft of sargassum weed adrift on the deep-water sea at night, seen from just off the swell at the raft's brim, amber-gold fronds matted into one floating thicket drawn out along a wind-combed lane, moonlit ultramarine water under the mat, a sargassum frogfish lodged in the fronds with its skin frilled into weed tatters, hatchling sea turtles tucked beneath the raft's underside, sargassum shrimp and mottled crabs studding the blades, flying fish with stiff outspread fins poised in the blue under the mat, clusters of small gold floats crowded along every stem, foam-ivory streaks combing the water either side of the raft, no one present
registers.target: a cluster of small gold floats

registers.name: float_cluster
registers.palette: amber-gold straps, ivory lace crust, ultramarine gloom
registers.scene: a thicket of sargassum blades seen from within the mat, serrated amber-gold straps branching off a woody stem, clusters of small gold floats crowded in every fork, ivory bryozoan lace crusting the older straps, threadlike hydroid fuzz fringing the blade edges, drift motes suspended between the straps, moonlit ultramarine gloom hollow under the thicket

registers.name: float_cells
registers.palette: amber casings, golden-brown discs, ultramarine gloom
registers.scene: the living tissue inside the float's rind, cell upon cell cased in amber and tiled into a curving mosaic, every cell crowded with golden-brown chloroplast discs strung around its rim, a clear sap pocket hollow at each centre, thick amber casings seaming cell to cell, tiers of cells receding into ultramarine gloom, no ground and no horizon

registers.name: alginate_eggbox
registers.palette: amber chains, teal calcium beads, ultramarine hollow
registers.scene: the casing material's own architecture, long amber polymer chains laid side by side in parallel rows, every chain kinked into a file of shallow pockets, a teal calcium bead seated in each pocket and zipping neighbouring chains together, further chain-pairs tiering away in the same combing, threadlike bridges crossing row to row, ultramarine hollow beyond the rows, no ground and no horizon

registers.name: carbon_atom
registers.palette: ochre core point, ultramarine haze, abyss black
registers.scene: one carbon atom pictured as nested shells of soft haze, an incandescent ochre point at its centre, two ultramarine mist shells standing off from it at even spacing, four faint bonding stubs reaching outward to dim ochre points hanging in the gloom, a hair-thin lit track cutting across the haze, abyss-black emptiness carrying no ground and no horizon

registers.name: track_cascade
registers.palette: ochre tracks, ultramarine sparks, abyss black
registers.scene: a cascade of luminous tracks strung through an abyss-black field, one hair-thin ochre track splitting into two, each branch splitting again and again into widening branchwork, ultramarine sparks blooming at every junction, the outermost branches fraying into threads, dimmer older cascades strewn deeper into the black, no ground and no horizon

registers.name: cluster_delta
registers.palette: saffron knot, dust-gold lanes, ultramarine void
registers.scene: a galaxy cluster fed by several parallel filaments of the cosmic web, each filament a lane of galaxies drawn inward, the lanes converging on one saffron knot of massed galaxies, ultramarine void lying between the lanes, faint sheets of galaxies stretched from filament to filament, dust-gold haze combing along each lane, countless galaxies strewn through the void beyond the knot

registers.name: brightest_galaxy
registers.palette: saffron starlight, molten gold core, ultramarine dust lanes
registers.scene: the cluster's brightest galaxy, a tilted spiral of saffron starlight, two great arms combed out from a molten gold core and stitched with amber star-nurseries, ultramarine dust lanes cutting between the arms, a mist of older stars thinning outward into abyss-black void, two ragged companion galaxies off its rim, countless stars strewn through the void beyond
registers.loop_target: a tilted spiral galaxy of saffron starlight around a molten gold core

registers.name: star_comet_shoal
registers.palette: ember-gold star, ultramarine tails, abyss black
registers.scene: a gold star and its shoal of comets, the star a swollen ember-gold disc, hundreds of comet heads sown through the black around it, every ion tail drawn into a long ultramarine streak and all the streaks combed one way off the star, teal dust tails curving from the brighter heads, gloom between the streaks, an ocean-blue world standing out in the shoal, stars strewn beyond

registers.name: ocean_world
registers.palette: moonlit ultramarine sea, saffron aurora, dune-brown islands
registers.scene: an ocean world seen from orbit at night, its hemisphere one sheet of moonlit ultramarine sea, storm spirals silvered across the far water, a saffron aurora ring set over the pole, two dune-brown islands trailing shoal-teal shallows, gold weed lines combed into parallel streaks over the sea between the storms, the terminator's silver seam drawn across the disc, stars strewn beyond the rim

registers.name: sea_windrows
registers.palette: ultramarine swell, amber-gold lanes, moon-silver glare
registers.scene: the night sea from an oblique vantage low over the swell, moonlit ultramarine water combed into long parallel windrows of amber-gold weed, the lanes drawn away toward the horizon, foam-ivory streaks lying between them, the swell ridged across the lanes, one broad raft of matted gold weed thickened at a lane's bend, moon-silver glare spread over the water beyond, no land anywhere on the sea
registers.target: a raft of matted gold weed

music_theme: a night drift on the deep-water sea — dark oceanic pads and a deep warm sub drone under slow blooming swells, one heavy low kick landing on the downbeat of every scale change, the pads thinning to a single held tone through the cell and chain bars, a wide swell where the splitting tracks fold out as the cluster's converging lanes, and a warmer settling figure as the star's comet shoal gives way to the moonlit sea
